scope: Synthetic portable public-palette rasters passed only to measureFramedWindow. No game engine, specification, solution, public-case campaign or per-game clock was used.

boundsReview.inputDomain: Nonempty rectangular uint8 palette matrix, at most 65536 pixels.
boundsReview.frameCountUpperBound: F <= floor(P / 8), because accepted components have at least an eight-pixel 3-by-3 perimeter and component masks are disjoint.
boundsReview.orderedPairVisits: F * F; the implementation scans all ordered pairs before retaining pairs with strictly different interior areas and the source geometry constraints.
boundsReview.retainedPairCountUpperBound: F * (F - 1) / 2; strict area ordering permits at most one orientation for each distinct pair.
boundsReview.perPairPixelComparisonUpperBound: windowCount * referenceWidth * referenceHeight; first differing pixels shorten actual work.
boundsReview.allocation: Admissible pairs are materialized; reference/image interiors and matching-window metadata are allocated during scanning.
boundsReview.certificationBounds: The consumed D request is separately bounded by node/depth/domain/time checks after measurement. Those bounds do not interrupt the preceding synchronous prefilter.
boundsReview.risk: Finite input size bounds total work but gives no small latency guarantee. Dense frames cause quadratic pair work; nearly equal windows cause repeated pixel comparisons and synchronous latency.
boundsReview.decision: No extra frame/pair/window cutoff, early ambiguity stop, cancellation or other grammar change was silently added. Any future bounded adaptation requires explicit qualification and parity review.

runs.counterQualification: compatiblePairs is the construction formula smallFrames * largeFrames, not an instrumented internal counter.
